name: mahjong-app
description: Production Hong Kong Old Style Mahjong table and installable offline PWA.

scripts.build:capacitor: rm -rf dist-capacitor && CAPACITOR_BUILD=1 vite build --outDir dist-capacitor
scripts.cap:android:debug: npm run build:capacitor && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:capacitor && npx cap sync android
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run && npm run build
scripts.qa:all: npm run qa && npm run qa:pwa && npm run qa:a11y && npm run cap:check
